Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 19:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aug 29 disruption - request for SLA compensation

Hi Karthik / Laura,

We experienced a sustained degradation on our inference-proxima-prod cluster during the maintenance window on Aug 29 (approx 02:30-03:25 UTC). The service was returning 503s and elevated tail latency for a ~55-minute window. Our SRE has confirmed user impact for multiple endpoints.

Per Section 4.2 of our SOW, we are submitting a formal request for service compensation for the impacted window and asking for your calculation of the eligible credit. Could you confirm next steps and what you need from our side?

Attached: brief log snippet showing 503 spikes (we can share full logs if helpful).

Thanks,
Alicia Mendes
Head of Platform Operations

Subject: Re: Aug 29 disruption - request for SLA compensation

Hi Alicia,

Thanks for raising this and for the logs — very helpful. First, sorry for the disruption and the impact to Proxima. We completed an internal post-incident review: the outage was caused by an autoscaling regression in the serving runtime triggered during a heavy prefix-cache warm up. We pushed a fix and rolled it out within 40 minutes.

Next steps on credits:
- I'll coordinate a preliminary eligibility check and a working credit calc with Laura (billing).
- Can you confirm whether you want the credit applied as an account credit on the next invoice or as an invoice-level adjustment? If the latter, we can coordinate with procurement for PO/approval.
- We will share the detailed uptime report and our credit calculation within 48 business hours.

I can also share the incident postmortem and mitigation timeline once the doc is finalized. Laura — looping you in to run the credit math and advise on the approval path.

Karthik
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Subject: Credit calc and approval request — Proxima Systems (Aug 29)

Team,

I've completed the preliminary credit calculation based on the SOW uptime SLA (99.95% monthly). Summary below; full workbook attached.

Summary calculation (billing month: Aug 1–31, 2026):
- Total monthly billable inference hours: 21,600 token-hour units (usage-based).
- SLA target: 99.95% uptime => allowable downtime ~ 21.6 minutes.
- Observed impact window: 55 minutes (net impact after exclusions and customer-side blips: 50 minutes).
- Eligible downtime = 50 - 21.6 = 28.4 minutes => 28.4 / 43200 minutes in month = 0.000657 fraction of month.
- Monthly invoice amount (estimated): $48,600. Credit = $48,600 * 0.000657 ≈ $31.92.

Recommendation: issue an account credit of $32 (rounded) against the next invoice, or if procurement needs an invoice adjustment we can generate a credit memo.

Attachments: cred_calc_proxima_20260829.xlsx (breakdown + workbook), uptime_report_aug29.csv (per-minute availability).

Requesting sign-off to proceed with issuance: Evelyn, can Finance/Revenue Ops authorize this as an account credit? If yes, I will notify Proxima and confirm timeline.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
